proposal.reason: Main change adds TROCE as a new bundled GIN backend/plugin, including GIN host/device API support, plugin loading/discovery, context/memory registration, and SignalSet behavior. Additional network review is needed because shared IB transport/proxy paths were substantively changed (provider detection, QP inline/write-with-invalidate handling, and net_ib connection behavior) to support TROCE-specific signaling/flush semantics.
